code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
spec:
  serviceName: catalog-db
  replicas: 3
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata: { name: data }
      spec:
        resources: { requests: { storage: 20Gi } }

# Pods: catalog-db-0, catalog-db-1, catalog-db-2
caption: Each ordinal gets its own PersistentVolumeClaim — data-catalog-db-1 reattaches to Pod catalog-db-1, always.
